company.name: Hypercore
company.shortDescription: Hypercore provides a cloud-based platform that manages loan portfolios from origination through repayment.
company.description: Hypercore provides a cloud-based loan management platform that supports lenders in handling loan portfolios from origination through repayment. The company’s software centralizes loan data, automates routine workflows, and tracks funding sources and performance metrics in a single system. Its tools also include customizable reporting and analytics features to help users monitor loans and generate insights. Hypercore’s platform is designed to replace manual processes and disparate spreadsheets with structured digital workflows that support ongoing loan operations.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based system for managing commercial and private credit loans from origination through maturity, including loan terms, schedules, balances, fees, amendments, and portfolio data.
